title: Refund eligibility
text: A refund may be considered only after order status and customer eligibility have been verified. Missing eligibility or order information requires human review.

title: Illustrative refund threshold
text: Sample only: amounts up to ₹5,000 may be considered when eligibility, order status, and authorization are confirmed. Higher amounts require human approval. Replace with approved policy.

title: Authorization
text: An operational action requires verified identity and permission. Missing or denied authorization must prevent execution.

title: Escalation
text: When evidence is missing, conflicting, outdated, or insufficient, do not assume approval; escalate to an authorized reviewer.
